name: Chest-supported incline row
notes: Prone row with the chest supported on an incline bench. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Lie chest-down on a bench inclined around 45 degrees with a dumbbell in each hand hanging under the shoulders.
guide.execution: Row the dumbbells toward the hips by driving the elbows back, pause, then lower to a full stretch.
guide.cues: Keep the chest on the bench. Pull elbows toward the back pockets. Let the shoulders reach at the bottom.
guide.mistakes: Peeling the chest off the bench; shrugging; yanking with momentum; cutting the bottom stretch short.
